data.body:
Closing as duplicate of sweating-revolting-oriole (b23c-8220-e09f-448a), bound to REB-7142 (Done).

Evidence (read-only, 2026-11-18 PST):
- Identical title. sweating-revolting-oriole's change 5d519764f20 (merged 2026-11-12) already did both things this ticket's criteria ask: it re-measured 2026-11-12 against the settled Cost Explorer day (about 3x intra-day fell to about 1.9x once billing settled; settled 2026-11-11 about 2.0x), identified the excess as the cache-read ceiling (about 3.1x the Opus 5.5 billed rate, against about 1.56x for the other directions, with cache reads almost 90% of Opus tokens), and updated the README band with that reason. No config key, env var or flag was added. Tests pin the band as a ratio only.
- REB-7141 has a lower key than REB-7142, so the outbound create for sweating-revolting-oriole produced two Jira issues; REB-7141 was not recorded as the binding and came back inbound as this ticket. Filed as highbred-fabled-lobo.

Propagation: status syncs local to Jira, so the next reconcile pass moves REB-7141 to the project's mapped closed status (Done).
